finalText:
All 11 application files are migrated. The only remaining `db.query` usage is in `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`, which its header explicitly marks as a vendored file that's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade — editing it would just be discarded, so I left it as-is (it should instead be handled via an upgrade or wrapper if `db.query` is ever removed).

**Note:** I didn't touch `cache.query(...)` calls (e.g. in `cohort.js`, `shipment.js`, etc.) — that's a different module (`lib/cache.js`), unrelated to this migration.
